author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 드물게 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 우리나라에서는 습지, 호수, 농경지 등에서 주로 겨울을 난다. 세계적으로는 개체 수가 많지만 국내에는 다른 두루미 무리에 섞여 몇 마리만 찾아온다. 서식지가 줄고 조각나는 데다 먹이도 부족해 위협받고 있다.

art.subject: Common Crane (Grus grus), adult as seen in Korean winter wetlands and farmland (plumage the same all year): head, foreneck and hindneck black, with a broad white band from behind the eye curving down the side of the neck to the upper back; a small patch of bare red skin on the crown; body and wing coverts mid-grey; primaries and secondaries black; long drooping tertials form a bushy grey bustle with black tips over the tail. Straight bill greyish-horn, paler at the tip; red eye; long black legs.
art.pose: foraging in a field alongside other cranes
art.scene: Korean winter wetland and farmland beside a lake; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: mostly grey body, black head and foreneck with a broad white band down the side of the neck, small red crown patch, black-tipped grey bustle over the tail, long black legs
adult, head and neck detail: black forehead, face and foreneck, small bare red patch on the crown, white band from behind the eye down the neck side, straight greyish bill, red eye
art.build: Large, tall crane, larger than Hooded Crane and smaller than Red-crowned Crane; long neck and very long legs, upright stance. Bill straight, sharply pointed, about as long as the head. A bushy bustle of drooping tertials covers the short tail. In flight neck stretched straight forward and legs trailing; grey wing coverts contrast with black flight feathers.
avoid: Do not paint a white head and upper neck with a dark grey body — that is Hooded Crane (Grus monacha).
Do not paint a red face patch with a grey-and-white striped neck — that is White-naped Crane (Antigone vipio).
Do not paint a white body — that is Red-crowned Crane (Grus japonensis).
Do not extend the white neck band onto the throat; the foreneck is black.
